caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular chest with a domed lid, positioned at an angle showing three sides: the front, the right side, and the top. The chest is primarily black, decorated with bold red drapery-like patterns and yellow leaf-like forms along the upper and side edges. The top of the chest features a subtle blue wave-like border and small red accents. There is a central metallic lock on the front face, detailed in gray. The edges of the chest are highlighted with blue and yellow border designs. The chest sits on a plain off-white or lightly yellowed background with no other objects or decorations. At the lower right of the image, the name "Frank H. Gray" is written in small, neat letters.
title: Toleware Tin Box
